summary: Evidence packet for the runx crm-cleanup skill (automerchlab/crm-cleanup@sha-44376c7817e7). A real post-publish dogfood run of the published package produced a sealed runx.receipt.v1 that passes runx verify with a production signature. This revision answers the prior review: the extractor now handles natural phrasings (not only the '<field> is <value>' template) and flags actionable-but-unextractable lines under needs_review instead of silently dropping them, and X.yaml declares the typed outputs (takeaways, field_updates, needs_review, write_proposal). The dogfood transcript is deliberately natural ('got around $75k to spend', 'moving them to qualified', 'I will send over a proposal by Friday') and sealed with 3 takeaway(s), field_updates {budget=$75k, next_step=send over a proposal by Friday, status=qualified}, and a gated write_proposal. source_url, X.yaml, SKILL.md and verification.json all resolve at a single source revision (commit 8eae1e5dd49704c4c20b54a8f15fb4b94954366f); this evidence packet and the report are its direct child and describe that same revision.
